original_question: Josh yԑ n’adwene sԑ ɔbԑtɔ na w’atɔn ԑdan bi. Ͻtɔ ԑdan no $80,000 na ɔde $50,000 asiesie. Wei ma ԑdan no boɔ kɔɔ soro 150%. Mfasoɔ sԑn na ɔnyaԑ?
question_template: {name_male, Josh} yԑ n’adwene sԑ ɔbԑtɔ na w’atɔn ԑdan bi. Ͻtɔ ԑdan no ${num_digit_1, 80,000} na ɔde ${num_digit_2, 50,000} asiesie. Wei ma ԑdan no boɔ kɔɔ soro {num_digit_3, 150}%. Mfasoɔ sԑn na ɔnyaԑ?
